evidenceLevels.source-only: Implementation or documentation exists; no execution proof.
evidenceLevels.simulated-integration: Integrated flow executed against local or simulated dependencies.
evidenceLevels.simulated-host: Flow executed inside a host simulator; not real-host proof.
evidenceLevels.exact-candidate: Checks executed against the exact clean candidate commit and lockfiles.
evidenceLevels.real-host-chain: Flow executed on the named real host/network with finality and provenance.
evidenceLevels.live-user: Observed participant journey with consent and redacted evidence.
evidenceLevels.release: Published artifact is cryptographically tied to the exact candidate and deployment record.
evidenceLevels.local-blocked: Useful local evidence that records an unresolved blocker and cannot promote state.

providerIndependence.policy: The supported runtime, development, test, migration, and deployment path must not require Supabase. Historical references may live only in clearly inactive archival material.

invariants.title: Only the receiver closes manual or external payment

source.section: 1. Money states are distinct, and only the receiver closes the loop

invariants.statement: A payer claim never equals receiver confirmation. Only a finalized transfer that exactly matches payer, receiver, amount, currency, network, and item may confirm that exact item automatically.

invariants.title: Canonical money is exact and conserved
invariants.statement: Canonical financial amounts use integer base units with an explicit currency scale; allocation, correction, refund, and settlement operations conserve units exactly and never rely on floating-point tolerance.

invariants.title: Participant signatures define authority

source.section: 5. Truth is the signed event log, held by participants

invariants.statement: Servers, hosts, chains, registries, delivery systems, and indexes may carry, project, or verify participant events but may not forge, rewrite, or become unilateral money or membership authority.

invariants.title: Failure cannot masquerade as financial success
invariants.statement: A failed, cancelled, unavailable, stale, or unverified remote, host, delivery, database, or chain operation leaves canonical financial state unchanged and is presented honestly to the user.

invariants.title: Recipient authority is explicitly verified
invariants.statement: A name, contact card, pointer, registry entry, or typed address is not permanent recipient authority. Payment destinations must bind the intended person to the current account, network, and capability with rotation and staleness handling.

invariants.title: Recovery locates state but does not grant authority
invariants.statement: Recovery heads and indexes are bounded locators and integrity aids; they cannot grant membership, confirm payment, move money, or override participant signatures.

invariants.title: Public systems never receive plaintext personal expense data
invariants.statement: Public chains, Bulletin, registries, logs, analytics, artifacts, and support evidence must not expose plaintext personal expense content or reusable secrets; evidence is minimized and redacted.

invariants.title: The supported system is Supabase-independent
invariants.statement: The active runtime, authentication, development, test, migration, deployment, and CI paths must not require Supabase packages, environment variables, APIs, Edge Functions, CLI commands, or secrets.
knownGaps: Exact-candidate environment and deployment configuration audit

invariants.title: Persisted financial state migrates safely
invariants.statement: Persisted schemas are explicitly versioned; migrations are ordered and idempotent, preserve a pre-migration backup, and quarantine ambiguous or corrupt financial records rather than silently coercing them.

invariants.title: Normal users never meet protocol plumbing

source.section: 2. The user never meets the plumbing

invariants.statement: Normal UI explains people, money direction, action, status, and recovery without adapter, protocol, host, SDK, native, proof, chain, or state-machine language.

invariants.title: Core money journeys are operable on mobile and assistive technology
invariants.statement: The exact candidate must pass narrow mobile viewports, keyboard navigation, visible focus, accessible names and status announcements, safe-area behavior in the actual host, and a VoiceOver or TalkBack walkthrough of the core money journey.

invariants.title: Network and asset provenance is exact
invariants.statement: Every chain-affecting claim records the exact SDK and host versions, network and genesis, asset identifier and decimals, contract address/code identity, participant accounts, finality evidence, and timestamp; mainnet metadata is never reused as Devnet proof.

invariants.title: Release proof binds the exact immutable candidate
invariants.statement: A release claim binds the clean Git commit, dependency locks, build profile and output hashes, CAR/CID or equivalent artifact identity, product name/version, host version, network/genesis, deployment evidence, ownership, and verification timestamp.

evidence.note: Records a dirty-worktree/exact-head blocker; cannot promote state.

knownGaps: published Devnet identity and ownership proof

invariants.title: Custody cannot be introduced incidentally
invariants.statement: Custody or escrow remains an open product decision, but no feature may introduce it incidentally. Any custody path requires a dated ADR, legal and regulatory review, threat model, explicit participant consent, operational controls, and release-specific approval.
knownGaps: No custody path is approved for the current beta

invariants.title: Claims never exceed their evidence
invariants.statement: Source existence, test existence, test execution, exact-candidate execution, real-host execution, chain finality, receiver confirmation, live-user observation, and published release are distinct evidence levels and must never be described as interchangeable.
knownGaps: PR claim/evidence review must be applied to the release train
